column2: This is highway unit! Target heading my way and not stopping! Engage and neutralize the target! Don't let him through!
column3: 这里是公路小队。目标正朝我这边开来，没有减速。交战并消灭目标。别让他过去。

column2: Target is approaching on highway. Intercept and neutralize! Roger that.
column3: 目标正沿公路接近。拦截并消灭！收到。

column2: Highway unit to base. Target inbound. Adjust your position and engage!
column3: 公路小队呼叫基地。目标正在接近。调整位置，准备交战！

column2: Highway unit 12, you are to intercept your target at all costs. Roger that. I'll move and shoot. Over.
column3: 公路12号，不惜一切代价拦截你的目标。收到。我会边移动边射击。完毕。

column2: Highway unit to base. Explosives are ready to detonate. Destroy that vehicle! Over!
column3: 公路小队呼叫基地。炸药已就位。摧毁那辆车！完毕！

column2: Base to Bomb Unit 5, you must stop this vehicle. Explosives are in place! Target is coming!
column3: 基地呼叫爆破5号，必须拦下这辆车。炸药已布置好！目标来了！

column2: Sir, I'm in position. Explosives are a go. Blow him up, soldier! Will do.
column3: 长官，我已就位。炸药可以引爆。把他炸上天，士兵！明白。

column2: Base to B unit, are you done setting up the charges? Yes, sir! I can see the target! I'm ready!
column3: 基地呼叫B小队，炸药布置完了吗？是，长官！我看到目标了！我准备好了！

column2: Unit 7 to Base. I'm behind cover and awaiting target. Proceed with caution. Don't let him see you.
column3: 7号呼叫基地。我在掩体后等待目标。小心行动！别让他看见你！

column2: Sir, the target can't see me. I'm about to engage. Roger that. Use the element of surprise. Over.
column3: 长官，目标看不见我。我准备交战。收到。利用出其不意。完毕。

column2: Base to highway units, stay hidden. Prepare to engage. Affirmative. Target is approaching.
column3: 基地呼叫公路小队，保持隐蔽。准备交战。收到。目标正在接近。

column2: Sir, he's coming! What are your orders? Stay behind cover. Engage as he passes. Got it!
column3: 长官，他来了！有什么命令？留在掩体后。等他经过时开火。明白！

column2: Update on highway target requested. Spike strip deployed. Target approaching. Roger that. You must stop this vehicle.
column3: 请求公路目标的最新情况。钉刺带已部署。目标正在接近。收到。必须拦下这辆车。

column2: Sir, spikes are ready! Roger that! Stop your target!
column3: 长官，钉刺已就绪！收到！拦下你的目标！

column2: Spikes unit to base. Target coming my way. Blow his tires! Stop him! Over!
column3: 钉刺小队呼叫基地。目标朝我来了。打爆他的轮胎！拦住他！完毕！

column2: Highway unit 9. Is the spike strip deployed? Yes, sir! Target is approaching! You must stop that car, soldier! Yes, sir!
column3: 这里是公路9号。钉刺带部署好了吗？是，长官！目标正在接近！必须拦下那辆车，士兵！是，长官！

column2: Target is in my sights! Your orders are to shoot him down!
column3: 目标进入我的瞄准镜！命令是把他打下来！

column2: Target is heading my way! Shoot that bastard!
column3: 目标正朝我这边来！打死那混蛋！

column2: Here he comes! Light 'em up!
column3: 他来了！朝他开火！

column2: I see him! Shoot that bastard!
column3: 我看到他了！打死那混蛋！

column2: Target in sight. Orders? What do you think?! KILL HIM!
column3: 目标进入视野。什么命令？你说呢？！杀了他！

column2: Dispatch, give me a report on the highway checkpoint points. All highway units are in position. Traffic has stopped and the city exits are secured. Roger that. Over.
column3: 调度中心，汇报公路检查站的位置。所有公路小队均已就位。车流已截停，出城路口已封锁。收到。完毕。

column2: Phantom Eagle to Base, approaching the drop zone. Roger that. Unit 16 to Base! We're currently holed up in the shopping mall. Can we get a transport out of here? Unit 16. Your transport will be there in. five minutes. Just keep those people safe until then. Sir, there's a lot of civilian and personnel on the ground in the city. We can't do this. We can and we are gonna do this. If this virus or whatever it is spreads, we could lose the whole country. The entire world! They will be a fair sacrifice. Over. Checkpoint 9 to Base! We missed our transport and are heading to the Iache River on foot. We'll be there in about ten minutes. Good man. You make me proud. Carry on. Phantom Eagle to Base, target in sight. God forgive us.
column3: 幻影鹰呼叫基地，正在接近投放点。收到。16号呼叫基地，我们目前被困在购物中心。能派架运输机把我们撤出去吗？16号，运输机五分钟后到。在那之前，保护好那些人。长官，城里的地面上有大量平民和人员。我们不能这么做。我们能，而且我们必须这么做。如果这种病毒——不管它是什么——扩散开，我们会失去整个国家，整个……世界。他们将是值得的牺牲。完毕。9号检查站呼叫基地。我们错过了运输机，正徒步前往艾奇河。大约十分钟后到。好样的。你让我感到骄傲。继续。幻影鹰呼叫基地。目标已进入视野。愿上帝宽恕我们。

column2: Sherman to Phantom Eagle. We have the President's approval. You are go for the drop. I repeat, you are go for the drop. Affirmative. Nuclear head armed, ready to drop. Heading to target, over. Sir, all transports are on ground. We're evacuating the riverbank. Roger that. Do it fast. We're pulling out, now.
column3: 谢尔曼呼叫幻影鹰。总统已批准。你可以执行投放了。重复，你可以执行投放了。收到。核弹头已解除保险，准备投放。正飞往目标，完毕。长官，所有运输机都已着陆。我们正在撤离河岸。收到。动作要快。我们现在就撤。

column2: Checkpoint to Base! We're unable to stop our target! It's continuing its run on Highway 65! You couldn't stop a single car. Give me a visual report! Sorry, sir. We're low on personnel here. The target is driving a black sports car with tinted glass. The driver's visual is still unknown. To all checkpoints on Highway 65, we have a moving black sports car. It must be stopped! Stay alert. Outpost 7 to Base! We're facing a massive crowd of undead here! We're holding but we might have to pull back if more show up! Maintain your position. They're dead and slow for Christ's sake. Just kill 'em all! They're hard to kill, sir! Just do your job. Yes, sir!
column3: 检查站呼叫基地。我们拦不住目标。它正继续沿65号公路前进。你们连一辆车都拦不住。给我一份目视报告。抱歉，长官。我们这里人手不足。目标驾驶一辆黑色跑车，车窗贴膜。司机的相貌仍不明确。65号公路各检查站注意。有一辆行驶中的黑色跑车。必须截停它。保持警戒。7号哨所呼叫基地。我们这边正面对一大群亡灵。我们顶得住，但如果再来更多，可能得后撤。守住你们的位置。看在上帝份上，它们又慢又是死的。把它们全杀光就是了。长官，它们很难杀死。做好你的事就行。是，长官！

column2: Checkpoint to base! We have a moving vehicle headed our way! Neutralize the vehicle! The driver could be infected or even dead for all we know! Roger that!
column3: 检查站呼叫基地！有一辆车正朝我们开来！消灭这辆车！据我们所知，司机可能已经感染，甚至已经死了！收到！

column2: Checkpoint to Base. Uh... the target is still going. Are you kidding me?! Maintain your position. The next checkpoint will handle him. To all ground troops on Highway 65, you are to intercept and shoot down the target. Over. Outpost 10. I need a sit rep. We're holding, but damn, there's a lot of them. Hold on. There's a LOT of them! We're almost surrounded! If they cover our east front, we're in trouble! Hang in there. Outpost 7, what's your status? We were overrun minutes ago. We're still on the move to South Square Park to make stand there. We're killing them, but more keep coming! Roger that. Don't lose South Square Park. Over.
column3: 检查站呼叫基地。呃，目标还在跑。你在逗我吗？！守住你的位置。下一个检查站会收拾他。65号公路所有地面部队注意，拦截并击毁目标。完毕。10号哨所，汇报情况。我们顶得住，但该死的，这儿实在太多了。等等。它们太多了！我们快被包围了！如果它们包抄我们的东面，我们就完了！撑住。7号哨所，你那边情况如何？我们几分钟前就被冲垮了。我们正在向南广场公园转移，准备在那里死守。我们在杀它们，但更多还在涌来！收到。别丢了南广场公园。完毕。

column2: Checkpoint to base. We confirm a black car coming our way. Orders are to take him out? Affirmative.
column3: 检查站呼叫基地。确认有一辆黑车朝我们开来。命令是干掉他吗？确认。

column2: Target has been identified as John Creasman, a local mechanic. Has a prior history of disorderly conduct. Nothing special. He's a freaking nobody. He's obviously trying to reach the tunnel to exit the city. We can't let that happen. Nobody gets out of the quarantined area. Base to Highway 65 personnel. Use spike strips to stop him. Over.
column3: 目标已确认为约翰·克里斯曼，本地机修工。有扰乱治安的前科。没什么特别的。他就是个无名小卒。他显然是想穿过隧道出城。我们不能让这种事发生。谁都不能离开隔离区。基地呼叫65号公路全体人员。用钉刺带拦住他。完毕。

column2: Sir, the target is approaching. We have a visual on his front plate. Sending the data your way. Over. Data received. Over.
column3: 长官，目标正在接近。我们看清了他的前车牌。正把数据发给你。完毕。数据已收到。完毕。

column2: Uh, it's a negative, sir. Target's still going. This is a bad joke! Damn it! Base to Hellfire. Change your course and head towards Highway 65. We have a civilian on the run. He must be stopped. Affirmative. Heading towards Highway 65 now. Over. To all highway units, dispatch some men behind cars and try using the element of surprise to stop the target. Sir, we have reports that 12 of our forward posts were completely overrun in the last 10 minutes. Where are the troops now? Scattered. Trying to regroup, sir. Damn it. Uh, have them fall back and, uh, regroup northwest near the Brighton Bridge. Yes, sir.
column3: 呃，报告长官，没拦住。目标还在跑。这简直是个烂玩笑！该死的！幻影鹰，改变航向，前往65号公路。有个平民在逃。必须截停他。收到。现在转向65号公路。完毕。65号公路所有单位注意，派几个人埋伏在车辆后面，试着用突袭的方式截停目标。长官，有报告说我们过去10分钟里有12个前沿哨所被彻底冲垮了。部队现在在哪？被打散了。正在重新集结，长官。该死的。呃，让他们后撤，呃，在布莱顿桥西北方向重新集结。是，长官。

column2: Base to Checkpoint 4! Stop this prick, will ya?! We'll try, sir!
column3: 基地呼叫4号检查站！拦住这混蛋，行吗？！我们尽量，长官！

column2: Sir, our fences are down! Zombies are marching in! I can't! We can't hold them! Hey, watch out behind! Come in, Checkpoint 5. Checkpoint 5. Shit. Base to Highway 65 units. Bring in the bomb squads. If this John Creasman gets out, this could mean a statewide epidemic. We have to stop him. Yes, sir! He's not the first jackass to try to get out. We'll blow him to pieces. Over. Unit 11 to base! Brighton Bridge is completely overrun! We need a new fallback position, now! Uh, set up a defense at the Chinatown Plaza! Sir? We just came from there! Uh, goddammit! Just move north! Just move freaking north! Yes, sir!
column3: 长官，我们的栅栏倒了！僵尸正涌进来！我顶不住！我们守不住了！嘿，小心背后！5号检查站，请回答。5号检查站。妈的。基地呼叫65号公路各单位。把爆破小组调上来。如果这个约翰·克里斯曼跑出去，可能引发全州范围的疫情。我们必须拦住他。是，长官！他不是第一个想跑出去的蠢货。我们会把他炸成碎片。完毕。11号呼叫基地！布莱顿桥已被彻底冲垮！我们需要新的后撤点，马上！呃，在唐人街广场设防！长官？我们刚从那儿过来！呃，该死的！那就往北撤！他妈的往北撤！是，长官！

column2: Checkpoint 5 to Base! We have a problem here! We're facing a lot of deadheads. Our fences are holding but if that Creasman guy runs them over, we're in deep shit! It's your job to stop this freaking car, soldier! Do not let him pass! Do not let the zombies through! You hear me? Uh, yes! Yes, sir!
column3: 5号检查站呼叫基地！我们这边出问题了！我们正面对一大堆行尸。栅栏还撑得住，但如果那个克里斯曼开车碾过去，我们就死定了！拦住这该死的车是你的职责，士兵！别让他过去！别让僵尸穿过这里！听到了吗？呃，是！是，长官！

column2: Attention, all troops. This is General Sherman. I am taking command of this operation. We're facing an enemy like we've never seen before. But keep your heads cool, and we're gonna get through. Now follow my orders carefully. All ground personnel are to converge to a defensive line along the Iache River. Our backs to the water, we'll make a final stand, in one single direction. We also have reports that some zombies have mutated. Be aware they are very strong and should be avoided at all costs.
column3: 全体部队注意。我是谢尔曼将军。从现在起由我指挥这次行动。我们面对的是前所未有的敌人。但保持冷静，我们会挺过去。现在仔细听我的命令。所有地面人员向艾奇河沿岸的防线集结。背水列阵，朝同一个方向做最后的死守。另外有报告称部分僵尸发生了变异。注意，它们非常强壮，务必不惜一切代价避开。

column2: Checkpoint to Base! We're in trouble here! We need orders! Maintain current strategy. We're about to be overrun. Current strategy is shit! I repeat, maintain current strategy. What?! What the hell is going on?!
column3: 检查站呼叫基地。我们这边出问题了。请指示。维持现有策略。我们快要被冲垮了。现有策略是一坨屎。重复，维持现有策略。什么？到底他妈的在搞什么？

column2: Checkpoint 7 to base. The target has gone beyond our checkpoint, but now we're overrun by zombies! We're moving out! Fall back to the Iache River with the other units. Now! Yes, sir! General Sherman to air support. Head over to Highway 65 for a carpet bombing on the target's location. Roger that. Unit 5 to base. We're currently sieged by a huge crowd of zombies. We'll try to circle around the river, but we've lost a lot of men. Unit 5, don't fight them. Just get your ass to the river. ASAP. Yes, sir.
column3: 7号检查站呼叫基地。目标已经越过我们的检查站，但现在我们被僵尸冲垮了！我们要撤了！跟其他部队一起撤到艾奇河。马上！是，长官！谢尔曼将军呼叫空中支援。前往65号公路，对目标所在位置实施地毯式轰炸。收到。5号呼叫基地。我们正被一大群僵尸围攻。我们会试着绕过河边，但已经损失惨重。75号，别跟它们纠缠。用最快的速度撤到河边。是，长官。

column2: Checkpoint 7 to Base. We have the highway target approaching. What are your orders? Let him through. Sir? Let. Him. Through. I have a surprise for him. Yes, sir!
column3: 7号检查站呼叫基地。公路目标正在接近。有什么命令？放他过去。长官？放。他。过去。我给他准备了个惊喜。是，长官！

column2: Sir, he got through. Sorry, sir. It's okay, son. To all Highway 65 personnel, prepare for a pullout. Sherman to Dispatch, send transports to all the highway checkpoints. Yes, sir. Hellfire units, arm your air-to-ground missiles and keep pursuing the target. Over. Affirmative.
column3: 长官，他冲过去了。抱歉，长官。没关系，孩子。65号公路全体人员注意，准备撤离。终止调度。派运输车前往各个公路检查站。是，长官。地狱火小队，装填空对地导弹，继续追击目标。完毕。收到。

column2: Sherman to Checkpoint 8, you are our last ground effort to stop John Creasman. Do your greatest. Sir, yes sir!
column3: 谢尔曼呼叫8号检查站，你们是我们拦截约翰·克里斯曼的最后一道防线。全力以赴。是，长官！

column2: Dispatch, send all transport choppers to the Iache River bank. We're evacuating the area. Yes, sir. Phantom Eagle, what is your position? Phantom Eagle to base, I'm currently at 64.7 and 32.4, heading to 79, over. Roger that. Maintain current course, over. Sir, we're at the Iache River. There are literally millions of zed heads slowly coming our way, but we're holding up for now. I see the transports coming. Hold position, and don't start evacuating until all the transports have landed. We'll need a synchronized retreat. Yes, sir!
column3: 调度中心，把所有运输直升机派到艾奇河岸边。我们要撤离这一区域。是，长官。幻影鹰，你的位置在哪？幻影鹰呼叫基地，我目前在64.7和32.4，正飞往79，完毕。收到。保持当前航向，完毕。长官，我们到了艾奇河。有成百上千万的行尸正慢慢朝我们过来，不过目前我们还撑得住。我看到运输机来了。守住位置，在所有运输机降落之前不要开始撤离。我们需要同步撤退。是，长官！

column2: General, sir, we're going to try and stop Creasman. What the hell are you still doing there? We're pulling out! Sir, we'll complete the mission. Good man. Do it and then get your ass to the Iache River ASAP! Sir, yes sir!
column3: 将军，长官，我们打算试着拦住克里斯曼。你还待在那儿干什么？我们要撤了！长官，我们会完成任务。好样的。干完就立刻滚去艾奇河！是，长官！

column2: Somebody! Please, help us!
column3: 来人啊！求求你们，救救我们！

column2: I gotta get out of here!
column3: 我得离开这儿！

column2: They're trying to kill me!
column3: 它们想杀了我！

column2: I must be dreaming! I must be dreaming!
column3: 我一定是在做梦！我一定是在做梦！

column2: This ain't happening!
column3: 这不可能发生！

column2: I ain't done nothing wrong!
column3: 我什么都没做错！

column2: They're trying to kill me!
column3: 它们想杀了我！

column2: God help us!
column3: 上帝救救我们！

column2: This is the end of the world!
column3: 这是世界末日！

column2: Please! Somebody help me! Oh, god!
column3: 求求你们！谁来帮帮我！哦，天哪！

column2: Please, stop! Help me!
column3: 求你了，停下！救救我！

column2: They ate my baby! My baby!
column3: 它们吃了我的孩子！我的孩子！

column2: We're taking heavy losses at the West Ridge! We're sending backup right away. What's your exact position? Uh... G32, E51! Roger that, sending backup now!
column3: 我们在西岭方向损失惨重。我们马上派增援过去。你的确切位置在哪？呃，G32，E51！收到。增援马上出发。

column2: Base is secure. Requesting orders. Maintain position.
column3: 基地安全。请求指示。维持位置。

column2: Base to 4-Base-Delta. Relocate south front. Roger that! Relocating now!
column3: 基地呼叫4号三角洲基地。转移到南面战线。收到！现在转移！

column2: Unit 8 to Base! We need artillery fire on Northside Park now! Negative, Unit 8. Our artillery has been proven ineffective against the undead. Maintain current strategy.
column3: 8号呼叫基地！我们需要炮火支援，炮击北区公园，马上！不行，8号。炮火对亡灵已被证明无效。维持现有策略。

column2: WE HAVE HUNDREDS OF CIVILIANS REQUESTING TO LEAVE THE CHECKPOINT! PERMISSION TO- Permission denied. Secure position, no one gets out. BUT SIR! THE HORDES ARE CLOSING IN AND- Oh, God! Secure the position! No one leaves, you understand? Your orders are to neutralize the civilians! YES SIR! FIRE! FIRE!
column3: 有几百名平民要求离开检查站！请求许可离开！驳回。守住位置，谁都不许出去。可是长官！尸群正在逼近，而且……哦，天哪！守住阵地！谁都不许走，明白吗？你的命令是处决那些平民！是，长官！开火！开火！

column2: Unit 4, you are to begin neutralizing civilians at your checkpoint. Over. Orders received.
column3: 4号，你负责开始处决你检查站的平民。完毕。命令收到。

column2: Unit 10 to Base! We're surrounded on the East Site factory! Requesting airlift out! Over! Denied. Secure position and await orders. Requesting airlift ASAP! THEY'RE GETTING IN WE-!
column3: 10号呼叫基地！我们在东区工厂被包围了！请求空运撤离！完毕！驳回。守住阵地等待命令。紧急请求空运！它们挤进来了，我们——！

column2: Approaching area Delta Tango. The rabbit is almost in the hole. Are you out of your mind? Forget the freaking codes, son! We're fighting dead people. Uh, sorry, sir.
column3: 正接近三角洲探戈区域。兔子快进洞了。你脑子进水了吗？别管那些该死的代号了，孩子！我们在跟死人打仗。呃，抱歉，长官。

column2: We need backup! This is Unit 12 on Burgony Street! Our humvee has turned over to our- we're surrounded! Agh! Shit! Please repeat that, Unit 12! What is your position? Oh my god! Ah, shit! They're attracted out on me-! Unit 12! Unit 12! Please respond!
